profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a self-taught Frontend Developer with a passion for clean and responsive design! I use CSS, Sass/SCSS, Javascript and React to create great looking, functional projects. Looking for an opportunity to use my code skills and design knowledge to create!

Portfolio: http://marleighmorgan.com

Github: https://github.com/kittywizard

positions.title: Senior Graphic Designer (via Quad)
positions.description:
• Mentored and trained 10+ team members in design 
and project management. 
• Modernized design templates for faster, 
more automated workflows.
• Completed up to and over 30 projects each week 
with strict daily deadlines.
• Designed in-store signage and digital assets for 
promotions including partnering with the Seattle 
Seahawks, Russell Wilson’s Why Not You Foundation 
and Alaska Airlines.

positions.title: Graphic Designer II
positions.description:
• Create and modify brand standards for Safeway & Albertsons stores in the Northwest and Alaska.
• Create new promotional sign kits for all new events and oversee their implementation in all other store signage and circulars.
• Design in-store and digital sign kits for all stores in the Northwest and Alaska for partners such as the Seahawks and Seafair.
• Manage incoming vendor art submissions, strict daily deadlines and quick turnarounds.

positions.title: Senior Production Artist
positions.description:
• Designed, delivered and proofread weekly ads 
and promotions for over 220 stores across the Northwest
and Alaska. 
• Wrote SOPs for production guidelines, trained and 
mentored 15 new production artists on brand standards 
and best practices.
• Managed weekly data submissions, and created templates.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
• Delivered print and digital assets for over 200 stores, 
including packaging, in-store promotions and social media.
• Pushed monthly updates to website using Wordpress.

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisting community members with coding and platform questions, moderating the discord server to help ensure a welcoming environment for all students.
